description: Steer a snake on a 6x6 board with U/D/L/R to eat all the food without hitting a wall or itself.

tasks.question:

. . . . . .
. . . . . .
. . . . . .
o o H . . .
. . . . . .
. . . F . .
Moves: U up, D down, L left, R right. Eating food grows the snake. Hitting a wall or your own body ends the game. Give at most 16 moves that eat all 1 food, e.g. RRDLU.
